name: Times Like These
source:
This is the story of a stranger, who unexpectedly enters the life of a happy couple, Michael and Katherine. After Katherine goes missing, will the stranger be able to bring her back?

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=29019]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
这是一个陌生人意外闯入幸福情侣迈克尔与凯瑟琳生活的故事。凯瑟琳失踪后，这名陌生人能把她带回来吗？

[译自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=29019]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
